name: vibesys
description: Skills that run VibeSys-style, measurement-driven optimization inside Claude Code, with domain skills for kernels, LLM serving, databases, microservices and native command-line tools.

plugins.name: vibesys
plugins.description: Resumable, measurement-driven optimization loop with parallel hypotheses, measurements and independent judging; the domain skills are in the vibesys-llm-serving, vibesys-database, vibesys-microservices, vibesys-cli-tools and vibesys-kernels-<backend> plugins.

plugins.name: vibesys-llm-serving
plugins.description: Domain skills for optimizing LLM serving systems, for use with the vibesys optimization loop.

plugins.name: vibesys-microservices
plugins.description: Domain skills for optimizing microservices, including Tokio services profiled with dial9, for use with the vibesys optimization loop.

plugins.name: vibesys-database
plugins.description: Tokio runtime diagnosis for database and other Tokio-based services.

plugins.name: vibesys-kernels-cuda
plugins.description: Domain skills for correct and fast CUDA kernels, with Nsight Compute and timeline analysis, for use with the vibesys optimization loop.

plugins.name: vibesys-kernels-rocm
plugins.description: Domain skills for correct and fast ROCm kernels, with rocprof analysis, for use with the vibesys optimization loop.

plugins.name: vibesys-kernels-trainium
plugins.description: Domain skills for correct and fast Trainium kernels, with the vendored Neuron NKI pack, for use with the vibesys optimization loop.

plugins.name: vibesys-cli-tools
plugins.description: Domain skill for optimizing locally built native command-line programs (text, filesystem, sorting and repository tools) without changing their behavior, for use with the vibesys optimization loop.
